validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: solidly confirmed independently. This is '广西天然气支线管网项目平南天然气支线管道工程' (Pingnan Natural Gas Branch Pipeline Engineering, part of the Guangxi Natural Gas Branch Pipeline Network Project), built by 广西广投天然气管网有限公司. Corroborated across FOUR separate government/regulatory processes found via search: (1) Guangxi DRC (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn) project approval 桂发改能源〔2018〕1492号 dated 2018-12-24, project code 2018-450821-57-02-022734; (2) Guigang land-resources bureau (dnr.gxzf.gov.cn) construction land-use pre-approval; (3) Guigang water-resources bureau approval of the water-and-soil conservation plan; (4) a 228-page EIA report '(公示本)广西天然气支线管网项目平南天然气支线管道工程环境影响报告书' filed 2019-08-28, listed on docin.com (independently url_verifier-confirmed, 200, contains both '平南' and '天然气'). Not a GEM-only entity. SPEC: LengthKnown=63.00km MATCHES independently (EIA/route description gives 63km total = 60.3km in Guiping + 2.7km in Pingnan county); Pressure=4.00 MPa MATCHES (design pressure '4MPa' in EIA description); StartLocation=Guiping/EndLocation=Pingnan MATCHES ('Guiping distribution station to Pingnan distribution station'); ProposalYear/Month=2018-12 MATCHES the 2018-12-24 approval date; Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission both reasonable (a branch/lateral off the provincial network feeding local distribution stations, not itself a town-gas grid). Diameter=250mm and Capacity=0.10 bcm/y and SegmentCost=216.76M RMB (2018) could NOT be independently confirmed or contradicted (search snippets truncated before the mm figure; no independent cost/capacity figure surfaced) -- left as-is, not fabricated, not contradicted. THE CAVEAT: the sheet's own cited ref for Status[ref]/Cancelled[ref] (t7290803.shtml, used for BOTH cells) is NOT a cancellation notice -- per search-engine cached snippets quoting its actual text, it is '关于同意广西天然气支线管网项目平南天然气支线管道工程项目核准文件有效期延期的批复' (a 2020 reply APPROVING AN EXTENSION of the 2018 approval's validity period), document number 桂发改油气〔2020〕1272号, dated 2020 -- not 2024. A document that grants more time to a still-live approval is the opposite of a cancellation, and its own date (2020) doesn't match the sheet's CancelledYear=2024 either. Separately, search turned up a genuinely different 2024 administrative action with an overlapping place-name -- a 2024 tender (dowater.com/chinabiddingzb.com/qianlima.com, winning bidder announced 2024-12-17/23) re-letting OPERATING RIGHTS for '平南县南河片乡镇管道天然气综合利用项目' (Pingnan County Nanhe-area township pipeline natural-gas comprehensive-utilization project), after the prior operator (per a toutiao.com item I could not load: '华源能源公司...经营不善、资金问题...无法继续经营') failed to continue -- but that is a DOWNSTREAM TOWN-GAS DISTRIBUTION FRANCHISE re-tender, an administratively distinct project from this upstream transmission branch pipeline, and citing it for P7678's status would be conflating two different entities. Net: I could not independently confirm this transmission pipeline is cancelled, and the cell's own cited source appears to say the opposite of what it's being used to support. Could not reach fgw.gxzf.gov.cn directly to read the full extension document (ConnectTimeout/ECONNREFUSED on every attempt, incl. WebFetch, curl, and url_verifier.py) -- this is a tooling/network limitation of this environment, not evidence either way, so filing as a caveat rather than a firm existence/classification concern. See status_reviews for the fuller status treatment.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Cannot confirm the recorded Status=cancelled/CancelledYear=2024, and cannot confidently propose a replacement. The cell's own current_ref (t7290803.shtml) is quoted in search-engine cache as a 2020 notice (桂发改油气〔2020〕1272号) APPROVING AN EXTENSION of the original 2018-12-24 approval (桂发改能源〔2018〕1492号) -- i.e. as of 2020 the project's approval was still alive and being extended, the opposite of a cancellation, and dated 2020 not 2024. The newest independent dated evidence I can pin down for the actual transmission-pipeline project is that 2020 extension. Everything downstream of 2020 (has it been built, further extended again, allowed to lapse, or formally cancelled) is invisible to me: fgw.gxzf.gov.cn / dnr.gxzf.gov.cn are unreachable from this environment on every method tried (WebFetch: ECONNREFUSED/timeout; curl: connection timed out on both :80 and :443 to 202.103.252.132; url_verifier.py: ConnectTimeout; web.archive.org has no snapshot of either shtml page: 'archived_snapshots': {} for both). A 2024 event DOES exist in the record but for a different, downstream entity (2024-12 operating-rights re-tender for the Pingnan Nanhe township town-gas distribution project after operator 华源能源's franchise failure) -- plausible that this is what got attached to P7678's Status cell by mistake, but I can't prove the mistake without reading the actual cited page. Recommend: a Chinese-fluent human/agent with working access to gxzf.gov.cn read t7290803.shtml (and check for any later 桂发改油气/桂发改能源 notice past 2020) before trusting either the current 'cancelled/2024' value or reverting it. Not applying the dormancy/staleness rule here because I have live 2020 evidence the approval was being actively extended, not left dormant -- 'proposed with no progress >=2y -> shelved' etc. isn't the right lens when the underlying source itself is in question.

summary: P7678 (Pingnan Branch, Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network) is a real, independently-confirmed transmission branch pipeline (63km Guiping-Pingnan, 4MPa, approved 2018) -- confirmed(caveat)/spec -- but its Status=cancelled/CancelledYear=2024 is built on a cited source that, per search-cache text, is actually a 2020 notice EXTENDING (not cancelling) the original approval, so the status is UNCLEAR/UNRESOLVED and needs direct human access to fgw.gxzf.gov.cn to resolve; do not trust the cancellation as-is.
